sessions.title: Welcome to FORGE
sessions.desc: Why FORGE exists, the stakeholder model, the three phases, the elevator speech, the Code of Conduct, and your commitment.

sessions.title: Building the Container
sessions.desc: The circle and its five rules, the group agreements, confidentiality and its limits, getting to know each other, and starting your journal.

sessions.title: Service Over Self
sessions.desc: What service is and isn't, three programs where men changed the culture from inside, and your first service challenge.

sessions.title: Thinking Controls Behavior
sessions.desc: The Think-Feel-Act cycle, Man A and Man B, automatic thoughts, and the thinking report.

sessions.title: Thinking Errors
sessions.desc: All eight thinking errors, what each sounds like and how it shows up in the dorm, then finding them in your own thinking reports.

sessions.title: Cognitive Restructuring
sessions.desc: The three honest questions, a challenge for every thinking error, the STOP technique, and rewriting a thinking report.

sessions.title: Understanding Emotions
sessions.desc: The emotion wheel, anger as a secondary emotion, where emotions show up in the body, and body mapping.

sessions.title: Emotional Regulation
sessions.desc: The escalation curve, 4-4-4 breathing and 5-4-3-2-1 grounding done along with the video, and when to use which.

sessions.title: The Anger Beneath the Anger
sessions.desc: How unprocessed pain becomes aggression, the four emotions anger covers, and the Beneath My Anger writing exercise. A heavy session, at a calm pace.

sessions.title: Understanding Trauma
sessions.desc: The Three E's, adverse childhood experiences and the private ACE activity, and why trauma is an explanation, not an excuse. A heavy session, at a calm pace.

sessions.title: Trauma Responses in the Dorm
sessions.desc: Fight, flight, freeze and fawn, how they show up in the dorm, and the difference between reacting and responding.

sessions.title: Coping and Safety
sessions.desc: Safe and unsafe coping, a toolkit for when to use what, and building your Safe Coping Card.

sessions.title: Active Listening
sessions.desc: The five components of active listening, the barriers that get in the way, and paired listening practice.

sessions.title: Communication Styles
sessions.desc: The four communication styles, “I” statements, and rewriting five “you” statements.

sessions.title: Giving and Receiving Feedback
sessions.desc: The SBI feedback model, how to receive feedback without getting defensive, and the feedback triad.

sessions.title: The FORGE Conflict Resolution Model
sessions.desc: The five-step conflict resolution model step by step, naming the heat, posture, being the third party, and practicing the model on your own.

sessions.title: De-escalation Techniques
sessions.desc: What to do when the heat is at 7 or 8: changing the environment, body language, distance, tone and pace, and the words that calm a situation down.

sessions.title: Mediation Skills
sessions.desc: Mediating between two men: staying neutral, refusing to be triangulated, the FORGE mediation ground rules, and the hardest mediations.

sessions.title: Personal Accountability
sessions.desc: What accountability is and isn't, putting down the lie, and the five levels of the Accountability Spectrum from denial to full ownership.

sessions.title: Integrity Under Pressure
sessions.desc: Integrity as words, actions and values that match, the four tests of integrity, and working through ethical dilemmas.

sessions.title: Making Amends and Moving Forward
sessions.desc: Restorative accountability, the ripple effect of harm, and how to make amends and move forward.

sessions.title: Empathy Development
sessions.desc: Seeing through someone else's eyes: the three types of empathy and how to practise each one.

sessions.title: Reading the Room
sessions.desc: Social awareness: seven nonverbal cues to read, and group dynamics and power structures in the dorm.

sessions.title: Building Pro-Social Relationships
sessions.desc: Healthy and toxic relationships, setting boundaries in here, and building the relationships that support change.

sessions.title: Problem-Solving Framework
sessions.desc: The FORGE six-step problem-solving model, from stopping to think through finding the real issue to reviewing how it went.

sessions.title: Decision Making Under Pressure
sessions.desc: What stress does to your brain, beating tunnel vision, pre-deciding, and writing your own personal rules.

sessions.title: Consequential Thinking
sessions.desc: The four kinds of consequences, short and long term, and mapping the ripple effects of a decision before you make it.

sessions.title: Growth Mindset
sessions.desc: Fixed and growth mindsets, the power of "yet", and changing the way you talk to yourself.

sessions.title: Finding Purpose
sessions.desc: Goals versus purpose, what Viktor Frankl learned about meaning, and a letter from your future self.

sessions.title: The Stakeholder Identity
sessions.desc: Passenger, victim or stakeholder: what you control, what changes when men take ownership, and your stakeholder commitment.

sessions.title: Skills Integration Practice
sessions.desc: Three layered scenarios that use every Phase 1 skill at once, worked through on your own with the debrief from class.

sessions.title: Self-Assessment and Reflection
sessions.desc: Reading back through your journal, rating yourself across the six skill areas, and writing your reflection for the portfolio.

sessions.title: Peer Evaluation and Feedback
sessions.desc: Giving and receiving feedback with the SBI model, the feedback seat and its ground rules, and how to prepare for the Knowledge Check.

sessions.title: Phase 1 Knowledge Check
sessions.desc: How the Knowledge Check works, what it covers, and a week-by-week review of Phase 1. You still take the check in person.

sessions.title: Portfolio Review
sessions.desc: The portfolio presentation and panel, the eight items in your Phase 1 portfolio, and what comes next.

sessions.title: Phase 1 Celebration and Phase 2 Preview
sessions.desc: Looking back over twelve weeks, the Phase 1 certificate and recommitment, and what Phase 2 asks of you.
